findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:83–117` defines `IsEffectiveCartier`, `isEffectiveCartier_iff`, and `isEffectiveCartier_top` in `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData`; `Relative.lean:57–198` likewise places the entire relative-effective-Cartier API there. The naming convention says declarations supporting an existing Mathlib type belong in that type's namespace, and adjacent consistency takes precedence.
findings.fix: Move these declarations into `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData` and update internal references accordingly.
findings.issue: All six closure lemmas (`isEffectiveCartier_{mul,pow,prod}` and `isRelativeEffectiveCartier_{mul,pow,prod}`, lines 42–149) are placed in `TauCeti`, while the predicates and adjacent API are in `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData`; this breaks namespace consistency and discoverability.

summary: The new effective-Cartier API is outside the namespace used by the underlying Mathlib type and all adjacent declarations.
